We have a few specific asks so our security and procurement teams can complete the technical evaluation:

1) A completed capability questionnaire that covers: network isolation, egress control, operator access model, KMS integration options, patching/upgrade process in an airgapped site, SBOM/Supply Chain attestations, and telemetry/telemetry-forwarding constraints.

3) Evidence that operator access can be scoped and audited (audit log examples are fine).

Can you provide the document set and any clarifying Qs? Our timeline is tight — we'd like to close the initial technical review by May 31.

Tom / Marta — please find attached our consolidated QnA and supporting artifacts for Atlas Health's technical review. Highlights and clarifications up front: 

- Deployment patterns: We provide three supported patterns and have summarized tradeoffs on page 2: (A) Fully airgapped appliance (no outbound connectivity; media-based upgrades), (B) Walled VPC (outbound only via customer-controlled proxy with allowlist), (C) Hybrid (internal service mesh + fenced egress). We included a recommended checklist for controls Atlas should validate during an on-site acceptance test.

- Operator access & audit: Operator roles can be federated via SAML/OIDC to your IdP. For fully airgapped installs we support one-time federated bootstrap plus local operator accounts; local operator actions are logged to a tamper-evident audit file and can be exported via signed bundles. Sample audit excerpts (redacted) are in appendix A.

- KMS & keys: We support AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault via a proxy connector for walled VPC installs and PKCS#11 HSM integration for airgapped appliances. We describe key rotation, backup, and emergency key-rewrap procedures in section 4.

- Patching & SBOM: For isolated sites we use signed image bundles and an operator-controlled media staging process; SBOMs and signatures are provided with each release. We document rollback steps and test coverage for upgrade paths.

- Telemetry: Default telemetry is lightweight health telemetry (metrics + encrypted heartbeat). For airgapped installs telemetry collection can be disabled; we can provide local telemetry stores and retention configuration.

Attachments:
- Atlas_PrivateDeploy_QnA_20270527.pdf (consolidated answers + appendix A redacted audit excerpts)
- network_diagram_atlas_v1.png (redacted topology showing ports/flows)
- operator_runbook_excerpt.txt (sample operator checklist and patch flow)

Next steps:
- If helpful, we can run a 45-minute technical walkthrough with your security team the week of May 31. Let me know preferred times.
- If Atlas needs additional evidence (SOC2 artifact references, SBOM signing key fingerprints), we can provide a controlled exhibit under NDA.

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.
